content: Ked singaya bwein yagan siwa̱youb. Magat agulivan mamagina tassinap yey, o magina gum-liba̱lab teitan yey; tage nag basiwa̱youb, agusinap gog makawan, agulivan mamagin kup iwawaysa mav.

Magat balivnek nanon Yowbad, o magat bakakin youd babaw ven watinow waseg, o youd babaw liba̱lab waseg, o magat balivan koy kweitan binoun bein palatan, basimounid, mo bivag ma̱wan; tage nag basiwa̱youb, tasimav gog yey; basesuna mav.
Magat bavgen gunwuliyoug beikous, o magat batam woug tatoneig bigabus kov, beikous, tage nag basiwa̱youb, nag kweitan maysan bakow wotet towen, nag.
Kukin kal bisiwa̱youb, mo bikapatul, bikalin nuwan, nag bikaypom son navavag, nag bikaypom sinap, o nag bikaypom butun, nag.
Kukin kal bisiwa̱youb, awoum kalbaleb ansinap, nag sivinan bikaleiwag, nag bikavikun, nag bininuway kalbaleb; o kukin biligen sinap kalbaleb nag bikalin nuwan, deisa bikalin nuwan sinap bwein waseg.
Kukin kal bisiwa̱youb kadilok tut babaw bikapatul; tut babaw bisimounid o binamis son waseg; nag bikawegweis won, nag.
Siwa̱youb nag beikous. Takinew siyas palopit nisesus; igaw siwotet biyakous. Takinew wudous tasiyas illivans kaeig kweitan kweitan wasigeis, igaw siwotet biyakous. Takinew sinap nises, igaw biyakous.
Nagein gog kakit takakins, adsinaps nag bivakaein geiguy silma̱nin. Igaw avakaein sinap biton, mo biyakous adsinaps, to kakit.
Igaw wagwa̱dig agulivan wadadan-wan, agusinap makaw, bula̱bol nanoug, peinan igaw gwad yey. Wankuyeim bo avakaein, sinapun gamagal mo alev.

Nagein gog sinap avakaein nag bakakin, misinaka kakit-wan mamagina kululuwan akin; igaw wanakougwaw mo bakinbunik. Nagein nag akakin bwein, igaw wanakougwaw bakakin bwein, mamagina Yowbad bweina ikikineig yey.

Kweitoun sinap nisesus bwanabwein; kweitan simounid waseg Yowbad, kwayuwein namis, kwatounun siwa̱youb; youd tasiyas bisesus bisigagas. Tage sinap towen siwa̱youb singaya bwein, bo imug sinap babaw wasigeis.
